simple.meaning: צָלָה (tsâlâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to roast.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across 1 Samuel, Isaiah, beginning at 1 Samuel 2:15. Its contexts include sacrifice, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָלָה (H6740).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: צָלָה (tsâlâh) / H6740 is traced through 1 Samuel 2:15, Isaiah 44:16, Isaiah 44:19 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for the priest; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”
